title: NTA JEE Mains Session I Online Form 2027
summary: National Testing Agency (NTA) , has released The Notifications on the official website for the JEE MAIN Examination (January 2027) . The exam will be conducted from 20 – 28 January 2027 , and NTA Application Form has started on 24 October 2026 & the candidates can apply until the 22 November 2026 . . Candidates must check the complete details for NTA JEE Mains Session I Online Form 2027. Link are given below.
qualification: Candidates who have passed their Class 12 or equivalent examination in 2025 or 2026, as well as those currently appearing for the Class 12 or equivalent examination in 2026, are eligible to apply for JEE (Main) 2026. It is strongly advised to thoroughly read the official notification before proceeding with the online application.
